A site blocker extension for Chrome and Firefox. Fast and not recording any data. I was sad that I found an easy to use one or one that has no recorded my usage: https://github.com/SiGe11/Lightweight-Blocker-Extension

This one I (mostly) did without LLMs, but the other project is vibe coded, but I'm enjoying it. An RTS made by Claude in Unity: https://github.com/SiGe11/StarForge2
